title: A little disappointed
text: A little disappointed. I have this mattress in the adult version, which is so much better. This childs one is not as firm, thinner, moves more and doesn't have the wool added to it. For the money, I don't feel like it's worth it. My 7 year old daughter is using it, so it supports her just fine. The mattress it touted to last 10 years though. I doubt that it will make it til shes 17. For the money, this mattress should be much sturdier. Super quality components though!
